subject: Onboarding form mismatch — request for provisional PO and spend cap
messages:
From: Priya Saito <priya.saito@astergrid.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: AsterGrid Billing <billing@astergrid.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding form submission — mismatch on line items / spend cap

Hi Mateo,

We just submitted our vendor intake form through the portal (attached: vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf) but Engineering flagged that the catalog SKUs and spend cap are not matching what your onboarding UI required. The form we downloaded showed three line items (integration setup, monthly usage, premium support) but the portal keeps rejecting the SKU mapping and there isn't a spend cap value recorded.

We need a PO number to proceed with ordering the initial integration work this week. Can you confirm what fields are preventing issuance (tax id, SKU mapping, or something else)? If there's anything you need from our side, Priya Saito (procurement) and billing are on copy.

Also, if a provisional PO is possible while we clean up metadata, that would be hugely helpful to avoid slipping the timeline.

Thanks,
Priya Saito
Procurement Lead
AsterGrid Inc.
attachments: vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Priya Saito <priya.saito@astergrid.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding form submission — mismatch on line items / spend cap

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick submission and the heads-up. I pulled the intake and saw two issues we need to resolve before final PO issuance:

1) SKU mapping: the line item descriptions are free-text and don't include our internal product codes. Procurement needs the catalog codes (e.g., INF-ENG-SETUP, INF-MONTH-1, INF-SUP-PREM) to map to ledger.
2) Spend cap/tax id: the spend cap field in the portal was left blank; we require a stated provisional spend cap for issuing a PO. We also need your company tax ID for our finance records.

If you can reply with the updated intake (with product codes) we can either:
- Issue a provisional PO immediately (PROV reference) to unblock the engineering kick-off (valid for 30 days, provisional spend cap), or
- Hold for the final PO once the form is normalized (longer lead time).

From procurement ops side, Monica — can you check if we have an open provisional bucket we can use for AsterGrid? Karthik, flagging for spend-cap approval if need be.

If helpful, I've attached a PO request template (ponum_request.xlsx) with fields we need filled. Proposed timeline: provisional PO within 48 hours after we receive corrected form.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Success — Redwood Inference
attachments: ponum_request.xlsx
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding form submission — internal notes and provisional availability

Mateo / Karthik — quick internal note:

I checked the vendor ledger and we currently have a provisional allocation pool for partner pilots (PROV pool 2937). We can carve out a temporary provisional PO for up to $80,000 but will need the corrected intake and tax ID to create the paperwork.

Action for procurement ops: once we get the corrected form, I'll generate a provisional PO (format PRV-2937-<vendor short>), set the spend cap to the requested amount (subject to final approval), and send the provisional PDF for signature.

Keep external waiting text minimal — tell them provisional issuance is possible and we need corrected form.

– Monica
From: Priya Saito <priya.saito@astergrid.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 14:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding form submission — mismatch on line items / spend cap

Thanks all — attached is the corrected intake (vendor_intake_form_v2.pdf). Changes made:
- Replaced free-text line items with catalog codes (INF-ENG-SETUP, INF-MONTH-1, INF-SUP-PREM)
- Added company tax ID: 98-7654321
- Requested provisional spend cap: $75,000 USD

We need to start basic integration next week; a provisional PO would cover the initial SOW and the first two invoices. If you can issue a provisional PO and send the PDF, that will allow our implementation team to proceed while we complete your onboarding checks.

Copying Billing for invoice routing (billing@astergrid.com).

Best,
Priya Saito
Procurement Lead, AsterGrid Inc.
